title: Yerevan street actions demanding Pashinyan’s resignation
organizer: ARF members / organizers identified by party source
demand_text: Resignation of Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan after ceasefire/war handling; source details are search-only.
threshold_50_evidence: Search results report road closures and 43 detentions but provide no simultaneous crowd size; arrest totals cannot establish 50 participants.

start_date.summary: NEWS.am search-result date reports a protest on 1 December.

location.summary: Search results place street actions in Yerevan, including Mashtots and Sayat-Nova avenues.

demands.summary: The party source states a resignation demand; NEWS.am search result labels the protest as demanding Pashinyan resign.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No participant total is reported; 43 detentions are not total attendance.

notes: Reported by party and NEWS.am; campaign relationship with later actions is plausible but not a separate event count.
open_questions: Exact participant count; source body not read; relation to broader November campaign.

title: Yerevan civil-disobedience street actions demanding Pashinyan’s resignation
organizer: ARF-led Homeland Salvation Movement / opposition parties
demand_text: Demand that the prime minister resign after signing the 9 November ceasefire declaration.
threshold_50_evidence: Panorama and ARF search results describe street actions and closures but no count; simultaneous 50-person threshold remains unknown.

location.summary: Search results locate street actions in central Yerevan.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Neither result gives a simultaneous participant count.

notes: Could be one of repeated campaign days; retained as a dated action, not merged automatically with other dates.
open_questions: Attendance and relation to earlier campaign actions.

title: Opposition rally and march in central Yerevan
location: Central Yerevan; march toward the prime minister’s official residence
organizer: Coalition of Armenian opposition parties; Homeland Salvation Movement
demand_text: Pashinyan’s resignation over handling of the Nagorno-Karabakh war/ceasefire; opposition set out an interim-government/early-election alternative.
threshold_50_evidence: RFE/RL reports the 5 December rally attracted thousands in central Yerevan; qualitative wording clearly exceeds 50, but it gives no exact total.

start_date.summary: RFE/RL dates the rally to 5 December.

location.summary: RFE/RL locates the rally in central Yerevan.

demands.summary: RFE/RL describes calls for Pashinyan to resign over the deal and opposition transition plan.

participants_original.summary: RFE/RL says 'thousands'; exact total not given.

organizer.summary: RFE/RL describes a rally of Armenian opposition parties.

notes: A continuation of the broader November opposition campaign, but a distinct mass rally held 5 December. Do not use the AP-origin Guardian article; its body was accidentally opened and excluded.
open_questions: Exact event size and national participation; relation to the November campaign; no official baseline/code.

title: Yerevan civil-disobedience demonstrations and street blockades
location: Central Yerevan streets and a metro station
scope: City-wide coordinated actions, with distinct locations not separately counted
organizer: Sixteen opposition parties under Homeland Salvation Movement
demand_text: Resignation of Pashinyan and a transition government to prepare early parliamentary elections.
threshold_50_evidence: CivilNet reports a couple hundred demonstrators blocked major streets and a metro station for several hours; this establishes more than 50 in the described Yerevan action.

start_date.summary: CivilNet dates the action to about 13:00 on 8 December.

location.summary: CivilNet locates the action on central Yerevan streets and at a metro station.

demands.summary: Reports say the action followed a demand that Pashinyan resign.

participants_original.summary: CivilNet describes a couple hundred demonstrators.

organizer.summary: The movement is described as sixteen opposition parties.

notes: Other towns also reported protests on 8 December, but the Yerevan crowd count is not extended to them or summed across cities.
open_questions: Whether the multiple Yerevan sites were one organized event; turnout at other towns; state response.

title: Opposition rally outside Armenia’s parliament
scope: Parliament-side rally; organizer says groups marched from different parts of city
organizer: Homeland Salvation Movement, coalition of sixteen parliamentary and non-parliamentary parties
demand_text: Resignation of Pashinyan and replacement with an interim prime minister.
threshold_50_evidence: Armenpress confirms an organized rally at parliament but gives no participant count; the 50-person threshold is unresolved.

start_date.summary: Armenpress body dates rally to 9 December.

demands.summary: Armenpress reports a resignation demand and interim-government plan.

organizer.summary: Sixteen opposition parties formed the organizing movement.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Opened article contains no attendance estimate.

notes: Do not import attendance from AP-origin reporting or unsourced retrospective estimates.

title: Opposition rally outside the government building
location: Outside Armenia’s main government building, Yerevan
scope: Government-building rally with street blockage nearby
organizer: Coalition of more than a dozen opposition parties
demand_text: Pashinyan’s resignation and political transition after the ceasefire agreement.
threshold_50_evidence: RFE/RL reports several hundred opposition supporters rallied outside the main government building on 10 December, exceeding 50.

start_date.summary: RFE/RL dates the rally to 10 December.

location.summary: RFE/RL locates the event outside the main government building.

demands.summary: RFE/RL describes opposition calls for the PM to step down.

state_response.summary: RFE/RL reports police used force to unblock a nearby street and detained more than 40.

organizer.summary: Coalition of more than a dozen opposition parties.

notes: The same RFE/RL report says police used force to clear a nearby street and detained more than 40. The event is distinct from the next day’s street-blocking actions.
open_questions: Exact count; precise linkage between nearby blockage, police force and rally.

title: Yerevan anti-government street blockades
demand_text: Calls for Pashinyan to resign over the ceasefire agreement.
threshold_50_evidence: RFE/RL describes street blockages, but no crowd count. CivilNet search results report 101 detentions; that does not establish total simultaneous attendance.

start_date.summary: RFE/RL dates street actions to 11 December; CivilNet search result dates a rally to that day.

location.summary: Search/body evidence places activity in central Yerevan.

demands.summary: Opposition activists called for Pashinyan to step down.

state_response.summary: Search result attributes 101 detentions to police.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No crowd total; arrests do not establish attendance.

notes: The arrest and street-blocking records may refer to overlapping action; exact episode structure is unresolved.
open_questions: Gathering size; attribution of the 101 detentions to a specific site/action; distinctness from 10 December.

title: Gyumri street-blocking protests demanding Pashinyan resign
location: Gyumri; brief Sayat-Nova closure followed by movement along Shahumyan Street and Victory Avenue
scope: Local city actions; possible same protest described by multiple outlets
organizer: ARF Gyumri organizers / local opposition groups (source descriptions vary)
demand_text: Resignation of Armenia’s prime minister; some participant rationale refers to post-war security and negotiations.
threshold_50_evidence: Multiple search results describe car/street blockages but none gives a simultaneous crowd count. Do not treat 37 reported detentions as attendance.

start_date.summary: Sources date Gyumri action(s) to 14 December.

location.summary: Aravot body reports the brief Sayat-Nova closure and movement along central streets; other records may refer to related actions.

demands.summary: Results state calls for Pashinyan’s resignation.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Aravot identifies ARF youth representatives and says 4–5 passing drivers joined, but gives no total or count of simultaneous participants; threshold remains unestablished.

police_response.summary: An ARF local committee representative told Aravot no police clash occurred; this organizer account is not independent police documentation.

notes: Potential same-story reporting among NEWS.am, Infocom/Tert.am, PastInfo and Armenian Times; do not count as independent confirmation without origin review. Supplemental local report adds route and organizer statement; it still supplies no total headcount and does not establish threshold.
open_questions: Total simultaneous participants; whether all outlets describe the same action; independent police account.

title: Homeland Salvation Movement March of Dignity
location: Yerevan; started near Sasuntsi David metro station
organizer: Homeland Salvation Movement, a coalition of sixteen parties
demand_text: Pashinyan’s resignation and early elections under an interim prime minister.
threshold_50_evidence: The procession article has no count. NEWS.am reports a short France Square rally following the march; UIC separately counts 2,700–2,800 people in French Square at 18:55. Do not apply that count to the march without a linked cohort/sequence decision.

start_date.summary: Armenpress dates the March of Dignity to 15 December.

location.summary: Armenpress says procession began near Sasuntsi David station.

demands.summary: Armenpress describes resignation demand and early-election plan.

organizer.summary: Homeland Salvation Movement organized the procession.

episode_link.summary: Armenpress dates the procession from Sasuntsi David; NEWS.am describes the following short rally in France Square and says this ended the day demonstration; UIC counts people in that square at 18:55. Evidence supports a likely linked sequence but does not prove counted attendance comprised the full procession.

notes: New NEWS.am report says a short rally at France Square followed the March of Dignity and ended that day's demonstration. Treat procession and square rally as one likely same-day sequence for event-boundary review; do not create two events or transfer the 18:55 square count to procession participants. Independent reviewer must decide final entity representation; eligibility remains pending_threshold.
open_questions: Independent reviewer to decide whether to represent the procession and rally as phases of one event; whether all counted participants were in the procession remains unknown.

title: Opposition rally in Yerevan’s French Square
scope: UIC counted square gathering at one time; linked by same-day NEWS.am account to the following-March demonstration, but no route headcount
organizer: Opposition rally; specific organizer not identified in the count report
demand_text: Resignation of Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan.
threshold_50_evidence: Union of Informed Citizens reports an individual aerial count of 2,700–2,800 people in French Square at 18:55, clearly exceeding 50.

start_date.summary: UIC report identifies the opposition demonstration on 15 December.

location.summary: UIC locates the count in French Square, Yerevan.

demands.summary: UIC says the opposition rally demanded Pashinyan resign.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Aerial individual count is far above 50.

organizer.summary: The report does not name a specific organizer.

episode_link.summary: Same-day event sequence is likely: procession began near Sasuntsi David; NEWS.am reports short rally after the March at France Square; UIC counts the square gathering at 18:55. Exact share of procession participants in UIC count is unknown.

notes: NEWS.am reports a short France Square rally following the March of Dignity and calls this the end of the day demonstration. Link E009 as the probable preceding phase; avoid separate event counting pending reviewer decision. UIC count is bounded to French Square at 18:55, not a count of marchers along the route. Candidate remains proposed_include, not verified_provisional.
open_questions: Independent reviewer to settle linked phase versus one event representation; no evidence allows transfer of 18:55 count to all march participants.

title: Syunik residents block routes during Pashinyan’s planned visit
location: Goris road, Syunik Province; separate Kapan/Meghri participation unverified
scope: Local Goris road blockade concurrent with Prime Minister visit; do not pool other settlements
organizer: Local residents and town mayors reported; affiliation/coordination uncertain
demand_text: Goris protesters said they would not allow the Prime Minister to enter Syunik; article discusses border demarcation/security concerns and other recent regional protests, but does not establish a specific policy-change demand for this blockade.
threshold_50_evidence: No simultaneous crowd count. Search results say residents blocked routes and the PM cancelled visits; explicit demand and policy target need confirmation.

start_date.summary: Results date route blockades to 21 December.

location.summary: Azatutyun body directly places the 21 Dec road blockade at Goris. Search-only reports mention other routes/towns but do not establish simultaneous groups or shared ownership.

demands.summary: Body reports protesters said they would not allow the PM into Syunik and contextualizes concerns about border delimitation/security; no explicit policy request by this Goris crowd is quoted.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No source reports a participant count. Do not pool Goris, Kapan, Meghri, or other routes.

state_response.summary: Search result says the prime minister cancelled visits; the relation is reported as consequence, not a coded response category.

notes: Do not aggregate different towns or conflate the route blockade with a later crowd outside the Investigative Committee. Supplemental Azatutyun/RFE-RL body narrows directly described blockade to Goris; it does not establish action at other towns as one gathering or meet threshold. Same publisher family means no independent corroboration claim.
open_questions: Whether the visit-blocking action made a qualifying state/policy demand; count of people at Goris; separate locations and attendance in other towns.

title: Homeland Salvation Movement rally at Republic Square
location: Republic Square and nearby government/ministry buildings, Yerevan
scope: Organized rally with same-day government-building pickets; camp continued beyond the date
organizer: Coalition of more than a dozen opposition parties / Homeland Salvation Movement
demand_text: Pashinyan’s resignation over the ceasefire and formation of an interim government to organize early elections.
threshold_50_evidence: RFE/RL reports thousands in Republic Square; this crowd alone establishes the threshold. No nationwide count is constructed from strike or regional roadblock claims.

location.summary: RFE/RL locates thousands in Republic Square; other same-day site actions are not added to its count.

demands.summary: RFE/RL reports demands for resignation and an interim government.

participants_original.summary: RFE/RL reports thousands, without an exact figure.

organizer.summary: Opposition coalition of more than a dozen parties.

state_response.summary: Police guarded government offices and a separate group briefly scuffled with security forces; who initiated this is unclear.

notes: Separate public rally from the called nationwide strike; 700 lawyers and reported employees on strike are not added to the square crowd. Overnight tent encampment continued beyond the assigned month; relationship between this day’s rally and subsequent camp requires review. The tent/overnight encampment is recorded as continuation C002; its duration extends beyond this rally and is not the rally end date.
open_questions: Exact crowd count; simultaneous size at other ministry pickets and Vanadzor; strike uptake; protester/state violence detail; camp end date.

title: Vanadzor–Yerevan highway blockade
organizer: Local citizens joining the Homeland Salvation Movement’s announced civil-disobedience actions
threshold_50_evidence: Search result reports a highway blockade but no number of people and no simultaneous headcount.

location.summary: The result locates the blockade on Vanadzor–Yerevan highway.

demands.summary: English and Armenian result headers report the Vanadzor–Yerevan route closure as demanding Pashinyan resign; attendance remains unreported.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: All captured results omit a simultaneous participant number. Highway obstruction does not establish a gathering of 50.

notes: Do not add blockading residents, fuel-station workers, lawyers or nationwide strike reports to the Yerevan Square crowd. Armenian-language NEWS.am and Yerkir results corroborate the local road closure/demand at search-result level only; counts and independent written origins are unresolved.
open_questions: Count, public gathering vs transport disruption, duration and relationship to national campaign.

title: Opposition protest outside Yerevan government headquarters
scope: Central building/road blockade; potential several-hour duration
threshold_50_evidence: Hetq/body and other reports identify 69 detainees but no total contemporaneous attendance. Do not equate arrests with participants; threshold remains pending.

start_date.summary: Search results date the demonstration/blockade to 24 December.

demands.summary: Search result says anti-Pashinyan demonstrators; exact demand is his resignation.

state_response.summary: Hetq and search results report 69 detained; Hetq says this was by 1pm and mentions a few minor scuffles with police cordoning the building. The total arrested is not turnout; the report does not identify who initiated scuffles.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Detention total is not the total protest attendance.

notes: The same-day result says block lasted more than five hours. Keep distinct from other Yerevan blockades pending event-link review. Hetq independently reports detention count/time and a few minor scuffles; neither supplies total attendance or identifies scuffle initiator.
open_questions: Attendance at one time; relation to other Yerevan blockades; scuffle sequence/initiator; official response document remains unavailable.

title: Yerevan civil-disobedience road-blocking actions
location: Several roads in Yerevan; another group marched to Republic Square
scope: Road closures and march reported; relation between them unclear
threshold_50_evidence: Armenpress says 15 protesters arrested and some citizens blocked roads; neither number establishes total simultaneous crowd size.

location.summary: Reports locate roadblocks and march in Yerevan.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Arrest count is not total attendance.

notes: NEWS.am separately reports marchers reaching Republic Square; whether it is the same road-blocking action is unverified.
open_questions: Attendance; route and relationship between roadblocks and march; response details.
